resources.string: A parrot with headphones and a monocle sitting on a safe
Permanently stores incoming message notifications, encrypted — even if the sender deletes them later.
Allow access so Kleene Petze can read and save incoming messages.
Samsung kills background services very aggressively. Without an exemption you\'ll miss messages.
All data stays on the device (SQLCipher / AES-256). No cloud, no tracking, no network — unless you turn on the update check in the settings.
Material You instead of Petze teal.
Once a day the app asks kleene-petze.celox.io for the latest version — no identifier, no messages. When off, the app never goes online.
Up to date — latest version is %1$s.
Snitches on everything. Forgets nothing. — Everything stays encrypted on your device.
Kleene Petze is free and has no ads. If it saved something for you, I\'d be glad about a coffee.
